scripts.build: vite build && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-assets.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests examples scripts '*.{json,ts}' README.md CHANGELOG.md GLOSSARY.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests examples scripts '*.{json,ts}' README.md CHANGELOG.md GLOSSARY.md
scripts.check:package: pnpm build && pnpm build:example && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.check:configuration: pnpm build && pnpm build:configuration && node scripts/check-package.mjs --configuration
scripts.check:report: pnpm build && pnpm build:report && node scripts/check-package.mjs --report
scripts.check:document: pnpm build && pnpm build:document && node scripts/check-package.mjs --document
scripts.check:voucher: pnpm build && pnpm build:voucher && node scripts/check-package.mjs --voucher
scripts.check:workflow: pnpm build && pnpm build:workflow && node scripts/check-package.mjs --workflow
scripts.check:shell: pnpm build && pnpm build:shell && node scripts/check-package.mjs --shell
scripts.check:details: pnpm build && pnpm build:details && node scripts/check-package.mjs --details
